crossRefs.note: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service…
Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh…
The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was…
These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were…
and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for…
also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of Yahweh’s house, and for all…
Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son…
not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and brought…
In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham…
For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;
for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by…
They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the…
They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the…
Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near…
Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.
David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of Yahweh’s house, six thousand were officers and…
four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”
For their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of Yahweh’s house, in the courts, and in the rooms…
This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

translations.web: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
translations.bsb: men from thirty to fifty years old—everyone who is qualified to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
translations.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.asv: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter upon the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.
